title: Push through your MacBook’s limits with this 11-in-1 Baseus dock for 30% off
content:
Macworld

Baseus Spacemate Docking Station 11-in-1

View Deal

There are tons and tons of docking stations you can buy out there, but so few of them can fix all of your Mac’s shortcomings. Well, this 11-in-1 Baseus Spacemate docking station is exactly what you need, and it’s down to $140 for Black Friday, a savings of 30 percent off its $200 MSRP.

The best thing about this dock is that it lets you add not one, not two, but three 4K monitors with both Macs and Windows laptops. DisplayLink technology bypasses the display limits built into most MacBooks, so you can run three 4K screens at once. That’s an incredible thing since many docking stations only support screen mirroring for Macs, and not full display extension.

The upright design with a magnetic base keeps your desk tidy, and a built-in LED screen shows what’s connected at a glance. A screen-lock button secures your computer with one tap when you step away.

While the extended screens are obviously amazing, there’s more to this docking station. The front of the device features USB-C and USB-A data ports so you can easily plug in flash drives without having to fiddle with the ports in the back. For the more permanent cables, you’ll find tons of ports on the back, including three HDMI ports, three USB-A ports, an audio jack, a 100W power-input port, and a Gigabit Ethernet port. That power input port can pass through 85W of power to your laptop so you won’t have to worry about using a different charger.

Stop wasting time and grab this Black Friday deal for this Baseus Spacemate 11-in-1 docking station for $140 while it’s still on sale.
